q.en: "Local authorities are working to ___ the region's cultural heritage."
q.bn: "Local authorities are working to ___ the region's cultural heritage."

why.en: The verb form "preserve" is needed after "to" (the infinitive).

q.en: "Many travellers experience ___ during their first few days abroad."
q.bn: "Many travellers experience ___ during their first few days abroad."

why.en: "Culture shock" describes the disorientation of encountering an unfamiliar culture.
why.bn: "Culture shock" মানে অপরিচিত culture-এর মুখোমুখি হওয়ার disorientation।

q.en: Which pair contrasts large-scale tourism with small-scale, environmentally conscious tourism?
q.bn: কোন pair large-scale tourism আর small-scale, environmentally conscious tourism-এর মধ্যে contrast দেখায়?

why.en: "Mass tourism" is large-scale and high-volume; "eco-tourism" is small-scale and environmentally conscious.
why.bn: "Mass tourism" large-scale, high-volume; "eco-tourism" small-scale, environmentally conscious।

why.en: "Off the beaten track" means unusual or less-visited places.
why.bn: "Off the beaten track" মানে unusual বা কম visited জায়গা।

q.en: Which word describes a destination being damaged by too many visitors?
q.bn: কোন শব্দ একটা destination খুব বেশি visitor-এর কারণে damaged হওয়া বোঝায়?

why.en: "Overtourism" refers to a destination being damaged by excessive numbers of visitors.
why.bn: "Overtourism" মানে অতিরিক্ত visitor-এর কারণে একটা destination damaged হওয়া।
